segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ נִטְמָא שָׁלֵם אוֹ רוּבּוֹ — שׂוֹרְפִין אוֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי הַבִּירָה מֵעֲצֵי הַמַּעֲרָכָה. נִטְמָא מִיעוּטוֹ וְהַנּוֹתָר — שׂוֹרְפִין אוֹתוֹ בְּחַצְרוֹתֵיהֶן אוֹ עַל גַּגּוֹתֵיהֶן מֵעֲצֵי עַצְמָן. הַצִּיקָנִין שׂוֹרְפִין אוֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי הַבִּירָה בִּשְׁבִיל לֵיהָנוֹת מֵעֲצֵי הַמַּעֲרָכָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If the «whole» Paschal lamb «or most of it became ritually impure, one burns it before the Temple [habira] with wood from the arrangement» of wood on the altar that was given to the owners of the Paschal lamb for this purpose. If «a minority of it became impure, and» similarly, with regard to «the» parts of the Paschal lamb that are «leftover,» which must be burned, the owners of the Paschal lamb «burn it in their courtyards or on their roofs, with their own wood.» Only «the miserly,» who want to save the expenditure of wood, «burn it before the Temple in order to benefit from the wood of the arrangement.»

moves.summary: whole or most impure is burned before the Temple with altar wood
minority impure or leftover burned at home with own wood; misers burn it before the Temple

positions.claim: wholly or mostly impure: burned before the Temple with altar wood; minority impure or leftover: burned at home with one's own wood, only misers use the altar wood
